## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +11.40%) ABOVE TREND. Financials solid: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Financials Outlook?**

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive tone but mixed internals: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — selective names showing strength, others lag.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclical/value exposure: emphasize Industrials and Energy names such as DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to lagging Tech names like ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND and PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND. Monitor the large-cap divergence before making broad style shifts.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA 900 resistance (NEUTRAL), AAPL 180 support (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM 200 breakout (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, DE 500 continuation level (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND.

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-85): ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm distribution. BA (-65): BA (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND — news-driven downside confirmed. INTC (-45): INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND — competitive pressure noted and price confirms weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style favored given broad breadth (9/11 sectors positive) and cyclicals leadership. DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major large-cap divergence (MSFT BELOW TREND vs AAPL ABOVE TREND and AMZN RECOVERY) and negative Tech news (ORCL, INTC) warrant monitoring before expanding Growth exposure.
